summary: Iteration 4 bug-fix validation COMPLETE. 33/33 pytest passing (14 regression + 9 iter3 + 10 new iter4). All 4 user-reported bugs verified fixed on live preview URL. Backend: /api/signal/active per-TF dict works - calling ?timeframe=5m twice returns same signal.id; switching TFs (1m->5m->15m->1m) does NOT destroy other TF's signal; signal.timeframe == requested tf for 1m/5m/15m/1h; cooldown (50% of expiration) active; MEDIA probability now generates signal (loosened filter), only BAJA + direct contradiction suppress. Frontend Playwright test performed rapid TF switching 5x - RESULT: 0 voice utterances spoken (voice loop bug FIXED), 0 console errors, BullsBearsGauge needle visibly rotated to -54.6deg with live score ~+67 (amplification Math.pow(|s|/100, 0.7)*100 + drop-shadow glow scaling working), ConfluencePanel rendered 5m/15m/1h per-TF aligned directions with Veredicto and updated on TF click, live 'COMPRA XAU/USD 64% ALTA PROB MEDIA' signal stable for 25 minutes (visible in screenshot).
critical_code_review_comments: STATE is in-memory per worker: if backend runs multiple uvicorn workers, active_signals dict is NOT shared -> different clients could still observe signal regeneration. Current supervisor config uses single worker so OK for now. For horizontal scaling move STATE to Redis/MongoDB.
signal_cooldown uses time.time() unix timestamp while expires_at uses datetime.fromisoformat. Both correct but two time systems in same module; consider unifying on datetime UTC.

usePolling genRef is an integer that increments per effect-run, combined with cancelled flag - robust. However intervalMs captured in closure: if intervalMs prop changes without deps change, new value won't take effect. Minor.

useVoiceAlerts COOLDOWN_MS=8000 is module-level constant - good. The `isNewSignal` detection uses `lastKey.current?.split('|')[0]` which after initial mount is the current key, so first real signal after mount might be classified as 'not new'. Acceptable because initialized.current skip handles first render.
BullsBearsGauge bars are still pseudo-derived from score (iter3 comment), not from STATE['ticks']. Cosmetic only.

compute_probability: when probability is MEDIA the 'reason' text says 'espera mejor confirmacion' but _make_signal now emits at MEDIA - so UI will show a signal card plus a NO TOMAR strip. Message is clear to the user.

api_active_signal: persisted cur signal is returned with its original confluence/probability recomputed each call -- good; but STATE['stats']['total'] is ONLY incremented on NEW signal creation, not on retrieval. Correct.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter4 validated all 4 user-reported bugs fixed. Key files: backend/server.py STATE['active_signals'] is dict keyed by timeframe (line 34); STATE['signal_cooldown'] dict keyed by tf (line 35); api_active_signal reads cur=STATE['active_signals'].get(timeframe) (line 656) preserving other TFs; cooldown check at line 670; _make_signal allows MEDIA prob (line 593 only rejects BAJA). Frontend: usePolling.js uses genRef counter (line 13) + cancelled flag (line 19); useVoiceAlerts.js has COOLDOWN_MS=8000 + composite key + reset on tf change (lines 11-47); BullsBearsGauge uses Math.pow(|s|/100, 0.7)*100 amplification (line 21) + drop-shadow glow filter (line 111). All 10 new iter4 tests pass: test_same_tf_twice, test_switching_tfs_preserves, test_signal_timeframe_matches_request (1m/5m/15m/1h), test_signal_emitted_for_media_prob, test_signal_confluence_does_not_contradict, test_signal_stability_3_consecutive_calls, test_probability_media_is_acceptable. Regression 14 + iter3 9 all green.
rca of the issue: Root causes (now fixed): (1) Previously STATE['active_signal'] was a single global field, so switching TFs overwrote the other TF's signal -> /api/signal/active always saw a stale signal for wrong TF and regenerated -> id kept changing -> useVoiceAlerts saw new id every cycle -> voice loop. Fix: dict keyed by tf. (2) Gauge needle used raw score/100 mapping so small |score|=25 only rotated ~22.5deg from center (barely visible). Fix: Math.pow(|s|/100, 0.7)*100 amplifies mid-range scores. (3) Strict filter (ALTA/ULTRA only) suppressed signal 90% of the time during normal market -> user saw 'no signal ever'. Fix: allow MEDIA too, reject only BAJA + direct confluence contradiction.
